name_raw: Villa in Abang - 2BR Villa with Stunning Pool | Moon Heritage Amed
description:
Our Moon Heritage Villa is crafted with reclaimed timber from a Javanese home. You’ll find beautiful hand-carved details throughout the Joglo, from its timber columns to the original 1875 gebyok doors.

Set on a private 500 sqm compound, the villa blends this old-world character with modern comforts. You’ll have a tropical garden, private pool and generous indoor-outdoor spaces all to yourselves, with plenty of space to share meals, relax by the pool and enjoy slow days together.
